thread:
maya: Quick thread to lock the run-of-show for next week's webinar. Goal: tight 40m session, live demo that proves cost controls + graceful degradation.

oliver: I can take the live demo. plan: show baseline generate -> enable batching + caching -> fast quantized variant -> failover to cheap fallback. keep the switch visual.

tina: I'll own the slides and 2-min context on why cost-aware serving matters for product teams. Need 3 talking bullets from speakers by Wed EOD.

raj: I'll prepare a 60s tech deep-dive on routing policies and a screenshot of Console showing per-route cost breakdown.

maya: Proposed run-of-show: 1) intro (4m) 2) demo & live switches (18m) 3) mini deep-dive + metrics (10m) 4) Q&A (8m). Thoughts?

oliver: That timing works. recommend a 30s dry-run of the model swap so we don't fumble.

sam: I'll moderate chat and surface top 3 questions. Also will run a single poll: "Which matters more: latency or cost?" at the 25-minute mark.

maya: For demo, can we include a quick curl example for the audience, then show Console metrics? keeps it tangible.

oliver: Example curl (copy into slides):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -d '{"model":"rw-fast-quant","input":"Write a one-line summary."}'
```

oliver: Then switch to `rw-std-8b` and rerun. show latency + token cost overlay.

tina: Design note: make the model switch animation big and bold. add on-screen labels: "Fast (quant)" -> "High-quality".

raj: I'll prep a tiny traffic-shaper script to trigger fallback, plus a Console trace to show route migration. will post the script in the doc.

maya: Logistics: rehearsal Thu 11am PT (45m). please join 10m early for AV checks. link: https://zoom.redwood/demo-rehearsal (placeholder).

sam: Confirmed. I'll test recording and streaming permissions during the pre-check.

oliver: Can we rehearse rollback in <45s? want a plan if the live demo hangs.

raj: Plan: if something breaks, hit the slide with pre-recorded clip of the demo (30s), then continue to deep-dive. I'll keep that clip ready.

tina: Speakers: drop final 1-slide bio + 3 bullets by Wed EOD into the drive folder. I'll stitch into the opener.

maya: Also need two short launch post headlines for socials. Tina & Sam, can you 2x concept headlines by Thu AM?

sam: I'll draft a few variations. thinking: "Serve smarter: cut token costs 3x without hurting quality" and a more product-y one.

oliver: Practical note: mute desktop notifications, use wired ethernet if possible, and keep a backup laptop.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Practical Serving — Rehearsal" Thu 11:00 PT. Invitees: maya, oliver, tina, raj, sam.

maya: Great. After rehearsal, let's run a 10-min retro in #marketing to capture any showstoppers.

sam: I'll collect questions during the session and put top 5 in the doc for the panel.

oliver: I'll upload the demo snippet and the pre-recorded fallback clip by Wed 8pm.

tina: Uploading slide draft now: https://rwd.md/practical-serving-draft (shortlink). please comment directly on slides.

maya: Thanks everyone. Keeping it crisp will make the message stick. See you Thu. :thumbsup:
